audio.description: Mix settings and the last loudness measurement

color.description: Color grade; on an adjustment item it applies to every layer below

saturation.description: Saturation multiplier (0 = black and white, 1 = unchanged)

describedShot.description: One described shot; at least one fact besides start and end

angle.description: Camera angle, e.g. eye, high, low, top, dutch, pov, ots

bestMoment.description: Source seconds of the best moment inside the shot

direction.description: Where the subject moves on screen, e.g. left, right, toward, away, none

looked.description: Source seconds of the frames looked at

move.description: Camera move, e.g. static, pan, tilt, push, pull, track, orbit, handheld, zoom, crane

size.description: Shot size, e.g. ECU, CU, MCU, MS, MWS, WS, EWS, insert

item.description: A timeline item; see the layer rules for which fields it needs

crop.description: Video picture: the visible part of the source frame (the picture keeps its place; zoom and pan move it)

bottom.description: Video picture: fraction of the height hidden at the bottom

left.description: Video picture: fraction of the width hidden on the left (left + right at most 0.95)

radius.description: Video picture: corner radius as a fraction of the visible part's shorter side (0.5 = circle or pill)

right.description: Video picture: fraction of the width hidden on the right

top.description: Video picture: fraction of the height hidden at the top (top + bottom at most 0.95)

effectSFX.description: Audio: the clip whose effect preset placed this sound; applying it again replaces it

effectText.description: Text: the clip whose effect preset placed this text; applying it again replaces it

fill.description: Fill the frame (cropping) instead of fitting inside it; the project's clipFill by default

freezeFrame.description: Video: source frame held for the whole item

id.description: Stable item ID, unique in the project

keyframes.description: Animation (video, text and audio layers; audio animates volume only): property → keys sorted by frame, counted from the item's start; values between keys follow each key's ease, and hold before the first and after the last key

color.contrast.description: Like the item's color.contrast; clips and adjustment layers

ease.description: Change to the next key: linear, in, out, inOut, hold or cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2); default inOut

color.exposure.description: Like the item's color.exposure; clips and adjustment layers

ease.description: Change to the next key: linear, in, out, inOut, hold or cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2); default inOut

color.lutStrength.description: Like the item's color.lutStrength; clips and adjustment layers

ease.description: Change to the next key: linear, in, out, inOut, hold or cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2); default inOut

color.saturation.description: Like the item's color.saturation; clips and adjustment layers

tilt.description: Vertical offset in output pixels, up

ease.description: Change to the next key: linear, in, out, inOut, hold or cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2); default inOut

volume.description: Gain in dB (0 = unchanged), like volumeDb; audio and clips with sound

ease.description: Change to the next key: linear, in, out, inOut, hold or cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2); default inOut

zoom.description: Scale over the fitted or filled size (1 = unchanged)

ease.description: Change to the next key: linear, in, out, inOut, hold or cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2); default inOut

linkedAudio.description: Video: ID of its linked sound item

linkedVideo.description: Audio: ID of its linked picture item

preservePitch.description: Keeps pitch when speed changes (default true)

reversed.description: Set by clip reverse: the original media and in-point, restored by reversing again

speed.description: Source frames per timeline frame; the timeline duration is kept

speedCurve.description: Speed ramp: points from t 0 (clip start) to t 1 (clip end), speed linear between them; speed then holds the curve's average. Set with setSpeedCurve.

textPreset.description: Text preset (text layers): built-in bold-outline, cinematic-serif, keyword-sticker, place-card, hook-title, chapter-card or any name (the first's defaults); default bold-outline

align.description: left, center or right (the preset's by default)

font.description: Font PostScript name (fonts list); missing fonts draw as Helvetica

lineHeight.description: Line spacing as a multiple of the font size (default 1.28)

positionX.description: Horizontal anchor: left edge, centre or right edge by align

positionY.description: Baseline position from the bottom, as a fraction

size.description: Font size as a fraction of the frame's short side (shrunk to fit 90% of the width)

tracking.description: Letter spacing as a share of the font size (default 0)

rotation.description: Rotation in degrees, counterclockwise, around the frame centre

zoom.description: Scale over the fitted or filled size

voice.description: Voiceover facts set by voice speak and voice check

text.description: The text the take was synthesized from

textHash.description: Hash of the text the take says (SourceHash.text); review notes when text differs

words.description: Words heard in the take, in its seconds

wordStyle.description: Text: show the words as they are spoken: a preset (highlight the current word, karaoke fill, or reveal) or {spoken, upcoming, past} looks of {fill #RRGGBB, opacity 0–1}; timings come from words, or are estimated

words.description: Text: timing of each word of the text (split at white space), in frames from the item's start; set by captions generate when the provider returns word timings

lut.description: A .cube file in the project luts folder

libraryItem.description: The library look (scope:id) it was copied from

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the library look's .cube it was copied from

marker.description: A marker; kind section starts a named section

media.description: A source file, referenced by path, never copied

alpha.description: A movie with an alpha channel (a video sticker); previewed without a proxy

data.description: The agent's own fields (P2-H10: takes, verdicts, reasons); free JSON, set by setMediaData

kind.description: Media kind; an image is held for as long as its items last (frames is the limit)

libraryItem.description: The library item (scope:id) it was copied from

license.description: Licence (P2-H8): free text, or an object with an open id; facts are the item's own

attribution.description: The credit line it asks for

id.description: Open licence id, such as cc-by, royalty-free, own

path.description: Relative to the project folder, or @assets/… in the workspace

charged.description: US dollars the provider reported charging

libraryItem.description: Library item (scope:id) it was placed from

provider.description: Provider that made or found it

mediaDescription.description: Shot facts written by an agent or the user (media.describe); open labels, other fields kept

shots.description: Shots in source order; they do not overlap

track.description: A layer. Items never overlap on one layer.

duckingEnabled.description: Music layers: suspend ducking without losing the level

hidden.description: Visual layers only: left out of preview and export

magnetic.description: Inserts append after the last item; drags reorder and compact

muted.description: Audio layers only: silent, and its speech stops ducking music

role.description: Semantic role; any nonempty value, these are assigned by BashCut

transition.description: A transition between two adjacent clips on a video layer

easing.description: How the tween runs: linear, in, out, inOut or cubic-bezier(x1,y1,x2,y2); linear when absent

kind.description: Transition kind: dissolve, whip, blink, zoom, spin, shutter, wipe, or any name with motion

motion.description: The tween as data: outgoing and incoming {property: [values]} over the tween; properties exposure, opacity, panX, panY, reveal, rotation, scaleX, zoom

beatGrid.description: Beat grid of one audio media

brief.description: What the edit is for (P1-D1); free JSON

canvasFromFirstClip.description: The first video or image clip placed on the timeline sets the canvas shape (portrait, landscape or square, keeping the short side). Cleared by any canvas change, so a canvas set on purpose stays; absent in projects made before it existed

clipFill.description: Clips fill the frame, cropping what does not fit, instead of fitting inside it. New projects fit (false); a project without it fills, as projects did before it existed

contentLanguage.description: BCP 47 language of speech and captions

output.description: What the project is made for (#441)

mode.description: Burned in, a sidecar file, both or none

track.description: Caption layer ID; default the first caption layer

captions.description: Export preset → how that output carries captions (P1-F4)

presets.description: Export presets, first one primary: review checks every output's platform and the Export sheet starts with the first

targets.description: Export preset → {integratedLUFS, truePeakDbTP}: that export's loudness target instead of the platform's (P0-K2)

plan.description: How the agent means to make it (P1-D2); free JSON

review.description: Review profile (#466): every editorial limit is the project's (a recipe skill sets them); core has none

accepted.description: Issue ID → {reason, rev, author}: warnings and notes kept on purpose (P1-E2); never errors

blackMinSeconds.description: Black picture at least this long is flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

blockExport.description: Issue ID prefixes (such as font, glyph, cut-in-word) that stop an export while open (P1-E1)

captionLineChars.description: Caption lines longer than this many characters are flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

captionMaxLines.description: Captions with more lines than this are flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

credits.description: Report credit lines, AI disclosure and licence flags in review and export results (P2-H9); off by default

disabledChecks.description: Plugin or provider IDs whose review checks do not run

hookSeconds.description: Text or speech must start within this many seconds; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

jumpCutChange.description: Picture change across a hard cut under which it counts as a jump cut (0–1); unset: no check, or the measured value as info

loudnessToleranceLU.description: Loudness further than this from the export's target is flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

maxMusicGapSeconds.description: A music bed stopping for longer than this is flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

maxShotSeconds.description: Shots on Main longer than this are flagged (with stillMotion, only those that barely move); unset: no check, or the measured value as info

maxSilenceSeconds.description: Dead air longer than this is flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

maxStillSeconds.description: Frozen picture longer than this is flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

minShotSeconds.description: Shots on Main shorter than this are flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

minSpeechCoverage.description: Tagged speech covering less than this share of the edit is flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

minTextSize.description: Text smaller than this share of the frame's short side is flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

platform.description: Overrides of platform facts when an app changes its interface (#469)

safeArea.description: Covered zones as fractions of the frame

severities.description: Check ID (or prefix before a hyphen, such as safe or shot-long; or a plugin provider ID ending in ':') → error, warning, info or off

stillMotion.description: Mean picture change under which a long shot counts as still (0–1); unset: no check, or the measured value as info

voiceoverMarginSeconds.description: Voiceover closer than this to tagged speech is flagged; unset: no check, or the measured value as info

tracks.description: Layers: visual kinds back to front, then audio
